caption:
DTF mein ek logo bhejna hai ya poori sheet? Confuse mat ho 👇

• Sirf logo hai? Upload karo: website use design maan kar size set karti hai aur sheet par laga deti hai
• Poori sheet pehle se bani hai? Wahi button: website use poori sheet ki tarah print karti hai
• File se samajh na aaye? Website khud poochti hai: ek design ya poori sheet. Logo hai to One design, sheet hai to Full sheet

👉 dtf.bulkplaintshirt.com

Aap zyada logo bhejte ho ya poori sheet? Comment mein batao 👇
